title: Osero's only live Demand Side deployment is a Pioneer Chain Instance on the Plasma network
content:
A.6.1.1.7.2.5.3.2.1 records the Plasma Instance of the Pioneer Chain Primitive, whose Instance Identifier gives the Network simply as "Plasma" (A.6.1.1.7.2.5.3.2.1.1.1.1). It is the only Instance in the entire Demand Side Stablecoin section.

The shape of the commitment is worth noting. The Pioneer Chain Primitive is chain-scoped by construction — an Instance names one network — so demand-side effort is concentrated on a single chain rather than spread across integrations. The two Primitives that would generalize the effort, Distribution Reward and Integration Boost, are activated but unused.

Read against the mandate in A.6.1.1.7.1, which frames Osero around "USD₮ liquidity" and stablecoin distribution hubs, the sequencing is coherent: establish presence on a stablecoin-oriented network first, then layer reward and integration mechanisms on top once there is distribution to reward.

The exposure is the flip side. A single named network carries all of Osero's demand-side activity, so the Instance's fate and the network's fate are the same, and diversification would require new Invocations rather than adjustment of an existing one.
description: Of three activated Demand Side Primitives, exactly one has been invoked, and it is chain-specific — a single-network bet rather than a broad distribution push.
